query: SELECT p.id, p.name, p.printfulSyncProductId, pv.id as variant_id, pv.name as variant_name, pv.retailPrice, pv.size, pv.color FROM products p JOIN product_variants pv ON pv.productId = p.id WHERE p.isActive = 1 ORDER BY p.id, pv.id LIMIT 100;
